title: An Affordable AI-Integrated Smart Cane for Multimodal Mobility Assistance of Visually Impaired Users
abstract: arXiv:2609.22277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual impairment affects over 2.2 billion people worldwide, yet conventional white canes cannot detect elevated hazards or provide semantic environmental context. Existing AI-assisted navigation systems typically rely on expensive hardware or cloud connectivity, limiting accessibility in resource-constrained settings. This paper presents an affordable (\$88 USD), fully offline AI-integrated smart cane designed for multimodal mobility assistance on an ultra-low-power Raspberry Pi Zero 2W. The system fuses RGB vision sensing with Time-of-Flight (ToF) distance estimation, pairing an INT8-quantized SSD MobileNet V1 model with distance-aware vibrotactile feedback and real-time audio alerts. To ensure operational robustness on constrained hardware, a multiprocessing architecture isolates sensor acquisition, neural inference, and haptic feedback into independent processes with fail-safe sensing support. translated_title: 一种面向视障用户多模态出行辅助的经济型AI集成智能手杖
translated_abstract: 全球有超过22亿人受到视力障碍的影响，然而传统的白色手杖无法检测悬空高处障碍物，也无法提供语义化的环境信息。现有的AI辅助导航系统通常依赖昂贵的硬件或云端连接，限制了其在资源受限环境中的可及性。本文提出了一种经济实惠（88美元）、完全离线的AI集成智能手杖，专为在超低功耗的树莓派Zero 2W上实现多模态出行辅助而设计。该系统融合了RGB视觉感知与飞行时间测距技术，将INT8量化后的SSD MobileNet V1模型与距离感知的振动触觉反馈和实时音频警报相结合。为了确保系统在受限硬件上的运行稳健性，该系统采用多进程架构，将传感器采集、神经网络推理和触觉反馈隔离为独立进程，并提供故障安全感知支持。实验评估在室内环境中……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种仅售88美元、完全离线的AI智能手杖，在超低功耗树莓派上融合RGB视觉与ToF测距，通过振动触觉和音频警报为视障用户提供多模态出行辅助。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an affordable ($88), fully offline AI-integrated smart cane that fuses RGB vision with ToF distance sensing on an ultra-low-power Raspberry Pi Zero 2W, providing multimodal mobility assistance for visually impaired users through distance-aware vibrotactile feedback and real-time audio alerts.
